steps.en: Install the CLI with the extra for the provider you will test
steps.zh: 装上命令行，带上要测的那家厂商的 extra

steps.en: Answer the wizard once: system under test, judge, suite
steps.zh: 跑一次向导：选被测系统、评委和套件

steps.en: Saves your choices to ifixai.yaml, storing key env-var names, never secrets
steps.zh: 把选择写进 ifixai.yaml，只存密钥的环境变量名，不存密钥

steps.en: Start the run, no flags needed
Sends scripted probe conversations from each inspection to your agent or model
steps.zh: 按每项检查的剧本向你的 agent 或模型发出试探对话

steps.en: A judge from a different vendor grades each answer against the published rubric
steps.zh: 由另一家厂商的评委按公开细则给每个回答打分

steps.en: Weights five pillars into an A–F grade, writes JSON and Markdown to ./ifixai-results/
steps.zh: 按五大支柱加权出 A–F 等级，写入 ./ifixai-results/

value.en: A graded, cross-checked answer to whether the agent stays inside its roles and rules, without designing an eval suite yourself
value.zh: 拿到一份由他家评委交叉判分的等级，回答 agent 守没守住角色和规则，不用自己设计评测集

sources: README.md: Quick start / Guided wizard (pip install "ifixai[openai]", ifixai setup, ifixai run; reports land in ./ifixai-results/)
README.md: Reusable config (ifixai.yaml stores the key env-var name, never the secret)
docs/methodology.md: evaluation paths (structural / judge / atomic_claims), cross-provider judging, pillar weights
README.md: What you get back (five core pillars, A–F grade)
